content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property specifically an apartment basement the court has determined that the property is community property and declared it as the applicants personal property the applicant is seeking a divorce and wants to retain their married name while removing the defendants surname the court has ordered the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings and other costs incurred for serving procedural documents the court has dissolved the marriage due to the fault of the defendant and declared the apartment basement as the applicants personal property the property will be divided between the spouses the state is ordered to pay the defendant for the costs of sending procedural documents
